title: Flamingo eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Flamingo body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="62" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#ff6fa8"/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="58" rx="14" ry="9" fill="#ff9cc4"/>
  <!-- Wing -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="60" rx="12" ry="10" fill="#ff4f90"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="58" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#ff7eb3"/>
  
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M36 50 Q30 36 34 24 Q38 14 44 18" stroke="#ff6fa8" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M36 50 Q30 36 34 24 Q38 14 44 18" stroke="#ff9cc4" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="17" r="9" fill="#ff6fa8"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="15" r="5" fill="#ff9cc4"/>
  
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="15" r="2.5" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="15" r="1.5" fill="#2a1a3a"/>
  
  <!-- Beak (eating snack) -->
  <path d="M54 19 L62 17 L60 23 L54 22 Z" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <path d="M54 22 L60 23 L58 25 L53 24 Z" fill="#e8922e"/>
  
  <!-- Snack (a little fish / cracker) being eaten -->
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="19" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#ffd166" transform="rotate(15 63 19)"/>
  <ellipse cx="61" cy="19" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffe09e" transform="rotate(15 61 19)"/>
  <!-- Snack dot detail -->
  <circle cx="65" cy="18" r="1" fill="#e8a800"/>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <line x1="44" y1="76" x2="42" y2="92" stroke="#ff6fa8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="76" x2="56" y2="92" stroke="#ff6fa8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Feet -->
  <path d="M38 92 L42 92 L46 92" stroke="#ff9cc4" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M52 92 L56 92 L60 92" stroke="#ff9cc4" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Little sparkle -->
  <path d="M72 36 L74 40 L78 42 L74 44 L72 48 L70 44 L66 42 L70 40 Z" fill="#ffe14d"/>
  <path d="M24 70 L25.5 73 L28 74 L25.5 75 L24 78 L22.5 75 L20 74 L22.5 73 Z" fill="#ffe14d"/>
</svg>
